description: This Java source file defines the EntityAlarmEntity class, which maps to a database table for storing alarm entities related to other entities within the Thingsboard platform. It includes fields for tenant ID, entity type, alarm ID, creation time, alarm type, and customer ID, along with constructors and a method to convert to a data object.
